service.name: switchboard
service.description: Reaches an owner's agents on the messaging channels people already use, and governs what each may do for whom.

scenario-authenticator.runtime_only_rationale: Identity is verified locally against the authenticator's published JWKS through packages/api-core/owneridentity. No Go package from that scenario is imported here, so no import-graph edge exists.
scenario-authenticator.degraded_behavior: Authenticated surfaces fail closed. Adapters keep receiving and recording inbound messages, but no turn is dispatched for a sender whose identity cannot be attributed.
scenario-authenticator.description: Owner identity for every authenticated API, CLI, and UI surface. This scenario issues no API key, stores no password, and owns no profile table.

prompt-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Agent descriptors are read over the generated Connect API by identifier. This scenario stores a reference and never a copy, so no Go package is imported and no descriptor is duplicated into local storage.
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Existing bindings keep resolving from the cached agent identifier, but no new binding can be created and no descriptor detail is rendered. Turns for already-bound agents continue with the last known grant.
prompt-manager.description: The source of truth for agent profiles, skills, actions, and the capability grant that names what an agent may do. Held by reference (OT-P0-008).

agent-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Runs are started over the generated Connect API. Scope attenuation, approvals, and DAG orchestration are enforced inside agent-manager; this scenario passes a resolved scope and receives a result.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Turns cannot execute. Inbound messages are still de-duplicated and recorded to their thread, and the sender receives a stated unavailable reason rather than silence.
agent-manager.description: Run execution, approvals, interactive control, and one-way scope attenuation. This scenario defines no second policy vocabulary (OT-P0-012).

tunnel-manager.runtime_only_rationale: A public origin is requested over the tunnel-manager API. Only channels whose descriptor declares a public_origin requirement consult it.
tunnel-manager.degraded_behavior: Webhook-ingress channels report unavailable with the missing public origin as the stated reason. Poll-ingress and in-app channels are unaffected.
tunnel-manager.description: Stable public origin for inbound webhook delivery. Required in practice once any webhook-ingress channel is activated; optional while only in-app and poll-ingress channels are live (OT-P1-012).

vrooli-bridge.runtime_only_rationale: Host-bound channels dispatch this scenario's own cataloged CLI verb to a remote machine through durable dispatch. The bridge carries the call and never learns what a channel is.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Host-bound channels such as iMessage on a Mac node are marked unroutable with a reason. Every host-local channel keeps working.
vrooli-bridge.description: The reach plane only: which machines exist, whether they are online, and whether this caller may send them anything. Adopted when the iMessage adapter activates (OT-P1-010).

notification-hub.runtime_only_rationale: notification-hub calls this scenario's adapter surface over Connect for the conversational channels it shares. There is no import edge in either direction.
notification-hub.degraded_behavior: One-shot notifications keep using notification-hub's own senders. Nothing in this scenario degrades.
notification-hub.description: A second caller into the same adapter registry, so a shared channel is never implemented twice. Notifications are never metered (OT-P1-015).

program-runtime.runtime_only_rationale: Reached only when an agent's capability grant names a program binding, and only through agent-manager's run, never directly from this scenario.
program-runtime.degraded_behavior: A turn whose grant names a program scope refuses that step with a stated reason; the rest of the turn proceeds.
program-runtime.description: Governed script execution offered as a grantable capability, not as something this scenario runs.

audio-tools.runtime_only_rationale: Speech capture, transcription, and synthesis are consumed over the audio-tools WebSocket and Connect surfaces when call mode is active.
audio-tools.degraded_behavior: Voice and call-mode channels report unavailable. Text and media channels are unaffected.
audio-tools.description: Local transcription and synthesis behind whisper, kyutai-stt, and kokoro. Consumed only when call mode activates (OT-P2-002).

persona.runtime_only_rationale: The one-time-code retrieval and operator-handoff contracts are called over the persona API during channel provisioning.
persona.degraded_behavior: Channels requiring a carrier or platform verification cannot complete provisioning and stay in a stated pending state. Already-provisioned channels are unaffected.
persona.description: Declared outward identity and the typed handoff for verification steps no machine may complete, notably A2P 10DLC carrier registration (OT-P2-001).
